procedures.name: EGOMI 1N
procedures.description: turn right HDG 130° to intercept R 075 JDG, proceed to GONEE at 6 000 ft, then as directed by ATC. turn limited to 210 kt IAS maximum.
restrictions: This SID is not used for joining airway.
2% CG is required until 6 000 ft for ATC purpose and 5.5% CG is required until 2 100 ft

procedures.name: SUPUL 1A
procedures.description: turn right HGD 265° to intercept R 225 JDG, proceed to EGOMI at 5 000 ft, then as directed by ATC. turn limited to 210 kt IAS maximum.
restrictions: This is not used for joining airway.
5% CG is required until 5 000 ft for ATC purpose and OBST avoidance.
